A new poll from The Economist/YouGov shows Democrats have an 8-point lead on a generic House ballot. The polling also found that President Trump's approval rating dropped to 33%. MS NOW Senior Editor and Opinion Columnist Anthony Fisher, Democratic strategist Basil Smikle, independent journalist Ahmed Baba and CNBC Fast Money Contributor Dan Nathan join Antonia Hylton to share their analysis as the midterms inch closer.

results.title: New Poll: Dems have 8-point lead on generic House ballot, Trump approval sinks to 33%

results.content: The new Economist/YouGov poll has Democrats up 7 on the generic ballot overall — and up 23 points among the most enthusiastic registered voters. Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters
results.title: An updated look at Trump's approval rating in every neighborhood

results.content: Recent polling data, however, suggests challenges for the GOP. A national Economist/YouGov poll released on August 4 shows Democrats leading Republicans by 8 points on the generic ballot. Additionally, Trump's approval rating has fallen to 36%, with 60% disapproving of his performance as president.
